sentences.text:
Subanti Devi & Others vs Mahesh Pd. Mehta & Others on 5 May,
2023
Author: Kailash Prasad Deo

Bench: Kailash Prasad Deo
In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 (Civil Miscellaneous Appellate Jurisdiction)
 M.A. No. 161 of 2018
 ........
Subanti Devi & Others .... ..... Appellants Versus Mahesh Pd. Mehta & Others .... ..... Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kailash Prasad Deo ............
For the Appellants : Mr. Shailendra Kr. Sinha, Advocate.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For the Respondent No. 2: Mr. Manish Kumar, Advocate.
The matter is being taken up through Video Conferencing.
Learned counsel for the parties have no objection with it and submitted that the audio and video qualities are good.

Learned counsel for the appellants, Mr. Shailendra Kumar Sinha has submitted that appellants /
claimants have preferred this appeal against the award dated 29.11.2017 passed by District &
Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Tribunal, Koderma in Motor Accident Claims Case No. 27/2007, whereby the application of the claimants namely, (1) Subanti Devi, wife of Late Navin Yadav, (2) Seema Kumari, daughter of Late Navin Yadav, (3) Sheela Kumari, daughter of Late Navin Yadav, (4) Kajal Kumari, daughter of Late Navin Yadav, (5) Neha Kumari, daughter of Late Navin Yadav and (6) Praveen Kumar, son of Late Navin Yadav for grant of compensation has been dismissed on the ground that claimants are not entitled to get any claim under the Motor Vehicles Act, rather the claim should have been filed by the claimants under the provision of Workmen Compensation Act.

entities.text:
District &
Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Tribunal, Koderma
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellants seeks permission to withdraw this miscellaneous appeal, as subsequently the claimants have been awarded compensation by Labour Commissioner, Patna in Workmen Compensation Case.
Learned counsel for the respondent no. 2-National Insurance Company Limited, Mr. Manish Kumar has no objection.
Accordingly, the present miscellaneous appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
